backend/main.mo: Primary Motoko canister implementing user profiles, stats, availability, chat, and admin/user authorization with various CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing recent UI feature requirements, impacted files, components, and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Index of frontend source files with brief descriptions of each component, hook, page, and utility module.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variable definitions for light and dark mode styling across the app.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document setting up the root container and loading the main React entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring authentication, profile setup, route definitions, and layout structure using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI component showing an access-denied message with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Full-screen login UI using Internet Identity with branding, background image, and sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component rendering the app's branded image.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Renders a group chat UI with message loading, scrolling, user avatars, and sending messages via hooks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays navigation buttons driven by route state and optionally shows an admin link.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Shows app header with logo, theme toggle, user avatar, and logout menu.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Allows users to view and edit their profile name and picture with upload support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Provides a low-opacity fixed background image wrapper around page content.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback and display name in various sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to user identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks to fetch and update the current user's profile using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Hooks to fetch the caller's role and check admin status via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, storing identity state, and handling auth-client initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, leaderboards, and availability data via an actor interface.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Implements a light/dark theme hook that syncs theme state with localStorage and document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Supplies hooks to fetch user directory info, including names and optional avatars, for given principals.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines CSS variables for light and dark themes with global styling.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Contains static branding constants such as app name and logo URL.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides date utilities for converting day IDs, formatting dates and times, and generating month grids.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Renders a form to add or edit availability for a selected date, using query hooks and navigational helpers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing users and availabilities with delete actions and directory lookups.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view displaying availability markers and linking to day detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Full-page wrapper rendering the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific day with edit and delete options for the caller.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays leaderboards with time filters and allows users to record wins or losses for available days.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page showing user info and placeholder match history section.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utilities to convert files to Uint8Array and generate initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility helpers for formatting, parsing, and generating time selection components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL or session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, including existing features, pending feature requests, metadata, and tracking info for a UI refactor project.
